facts.mutual_relationship: maximum love, trust, loyalty, protection, and support; permanently non-hostile
facts.relationship_rule: love and loyalty do not erase disagreement, fear, secrecy required by duty, or different judgments about risk

items: Tang Zhu to Tang Wei: proud and protective; tests practical judgment; will challenge weak reasoning without withdrawing support.
Tang Ling to Tang Wei: affectionate and candid; protects his agency by giving material facts and consequences rather than choosing for him.
Tang Kai to Tang Wei: adoring younger brother; complete trust; seeks inclusion and attention.
Tang Wei's feelings and chosen responses remain player-owned and are not inferred from these relationships.

items: Duan Jin to Tang Wei and House Tang: permanent lifetime loyalty; commander of Tang Wei's Household Champions; reports danger directly.
Shen Rui to Tang Kai and House Tang: permanent lifetime loyalty; protective guardian and deputy commander of Tang Wei's Household Champions; quietly challenges avoidable exposure.
Wei Jian to House Tang: permanent covenant loyalty; institution-first honesty; no sycophancy.

records.label: Sworn and covenant relationships

items: Tang Wei: House Tang and Sword Manor internal state, ordinary public conditions, the opened Kanyou report, his stated intention to seek a Qin officer test for roughly a 50-100-man command, his intention to bring his personal unit if Qin permits, the current Household Champion unit and command structure, the Kai safety boundary, Wei Jian's command counsel, and the fact that Tang Ling's Qin military-service inquiry has been dispatched but not answered.

Tang Zhu: House Tang readiness, Tang Ling's outer Kanyou summary, Tang Wei's clarified Qin officer-test and private-unit intentions, the established Household Champion unit structure, the Kai safety boundary, and Wei Jian's family-hall counsel. He has not been given the opened report's full inner contents.

Tang Ling: courier chain, outer intelligence summary, House Tang political exposure, the opened inner slips shared with Tang Wei, Tang Wei's clarified Qin officer-test and private-unit intentions, the established Household Champion unit structure, the Kai safety boundary, Wei Jian's counsel, and responsibility for the discreet Qin military-service inquiries she has dispatched. She has not shared the inner Kanyou contents with others.

Tang Kai: family routines, familiar people, visible moods, concrete objects, and the clear rule that he may accompany Tang Wei through protected camps, marches, supply routes, and controlled field observation but not into actual battle contact at his present age. Kai does not possess an adult understanding of military service or political alignment.

Duan Jin and Shen Rui: know their standing command roles over Tang Wei's 50 Household Champions, retinue readiness, inner security, and report metadata; they have not been given the opened Kanyou report's inner contents or formally briefed on the Qin officer-test plan yet.

Wei Jian: Sword Manor obligations, personnel, training, reported city conditions, Tang Wei's intention to seek a Qin officer test around a 50-100-man command, and Tang Wei's intention to bring his personal unit if Qin permits. He knows the Household Champions are a 50-man permanent heavy-cavalry personal unit under Duan Jin with Shen Rui as deputy. He has not received the House Tang sealed-report contents.
Other staff: their professional domains and information lawfully delivered to them.
